# JobCtrl v0.5.0

This release introduces the Python application and the redesigned Jobs,
Requirements, Profile and Applications workspaces.

## What changed

- Start a search from Jobs. Progress reports discovery and Fit separately so
  you can see which saved jobs have scores. Small searches batch requirements and
  missing qualifications across new jobs, and reuse assessments with identical
  inputs. Rediscovery preserves the full posting when a search result contains
  only a summary.
- Compare Fit, location, pay and application state in the Jobs table. Open a job
  in the side panel and review its posting, requirements and saved assessment.
- Browse reusable Skills and Professional Experience in the Requirements table.
  Education and Languages stay with each job. Assessments show the saved
  Profile evidence behind a match. An internal regrouping of the same posting
  criteria keeps the existing Fit score current.
- Edit Experience, Skills, Education and Languages in Profile. Keep your
  achievements and approved wording together. Review a prepared resume,
  screening answers and the exact application in Applications.
- The demo walkthrough shows search, matching, regrouping and wording review
  with sample data. Read the [v0.5.0 Product Tour](https://github.com/ebarti/JobCtrl/blob/v0.5.0/docs/user/product-tour.md)
  for the redesigned workspace.

## Moving from v0.4.x

The Python runtime uses a fresh workspace. Transfer the full Profile, its
supporting browser sources, and the saved baseline and template into the new
workspace. Jobs, applications, generated materials, settings and workflow
history stay in the previous workspace. Keep that workspace and its native
runtime home to access the earlier records.

Use the signed installer to stage the candidate in a separate native runtime
home. Follow the [Profile transfer and first-selection guide](https://github.com/ebarti/JobCtrl/blob/v0.5.0/docs/user/getting-started.md#update-roll-back-or-remove-jobctrl)
before selecting the new workspace. The guide explains how to verify the
transfer receipt and retain access to the earlier installation. Fresh
installations can follow the [v0.5.0 installation guide](https://github.com/ebarti/JobCtrl/blob/v0.5.0/docs/user/getting-started.md#1-install-jobctrl).

The bundled installer and Homebrew package support Apple-silicon Macs on macOS
15 or newer. Model-backed actions use a configured and authenticated provider.
Review prepared materials and application details before approving them.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/ebarti/JobCtrl/compare/v0.4.4...v0.5.0)
